description: Frontend: the complete web surface for per-form sharing and invite acceptance. Add the shared types; extend FormSharePage with the invite card + shares list + revoke; add the AcceptInvitePage and its protected route; wire the invite-token round-trip through GuestOnly, AuthGuard, SignupPage and LoginPage. One coherent frontend unit — typechecks and lints as a whole. Depends on FEAT-002 (consumes the /api/forms/:formId/shares, /api/invites/:token and accept endpoints and their response shapes). No new API client functions are needed (api.get/post/delete + publicGet cover everything).
steps: Edit c:\Qivo\apps\web\src\types\index.ts: add FormShareRole, FormShareStatus, FormShare, SharedWithMeItem, InvitePreview exactly per design.md's Types block.

Edit c:\Qivo\apps\web\src\pages\FormSharePage.tsx: add state (shares, inviteEmail, inviteRole default "RESPONDER", inviting, shareMessage, shareError); in the existing loadForm effect also fetch `api.get<{ shares: FormShare[] }>(`/api/forms/${formId}/shares`)` and set it, surfacing a 403 as a benign 'no permission to manage sharing' note rather than breaking the page; add handleSendInvite (api.post to /api/forms/:formId/shares with { email: lowercased, role }, success message that mentions the emailed sign-up link when the returned share is PENDING, reload shares) and handleRevoke (confirm, api.delete, reload); render a new card below the QR/link card with a role <select> (RESPONDER/EDITOR/VIEWER) + short role descriptions and a shares list with email/linked-user, a role pill, a status pill (Pending amber / Accepted green) and a revoke button. Mirror TeamPage.tsx's invite UX and reuse existing CSS classes (status-pill, secondary-button, danger-button, submit-error, editor-message).

Create c:\Qivo\apps\web\src\pages\AcceptInvitePage.tsx per design.md: read token from the query string (error state if absent); on mount `publicGet<{ invite: InvitePreview }>(`/api/invites/${token}`)` to show title/role/inviter and handle INVALID_TOKEN; if status is ACCEPTED show an 'already accepted' state with a button to open the form; an Accept button calls `api.post<{ formId; slug; role }>(`/api/invites/${token}/accept`)` and redirects by role (EDITOR -> /forms/:id/edit, VIEWER -> /forms/:id/responses, RESPONDER -> /f/:slug); branch errors on ApiRequestError.code (FORBIDDEN email-mismatch message, INVALID_TOKEN message).

Edit c:\Qivo\apps\web\src\App.tsx: import AcceptInvitePage; add `<Route path="/accept-invite" element={<Protected>{() => <AcceptInvitePage />}</Protected>} />` in the protected group; update GuestOnly to `import { Navigate, useLocation } from "react-router-dom"`, add `const location = useLocation();`, and redirect a logged-in user to `/accept-invite?token=<invite>` when `?invite=` is present else `/dashboard`, per design.md's GuestOnly code block.

Edit c:\Qivo\apps\web\src\components\AuthGuard.tsx: special-case the no-user redirect so an unauthenticated hit on /accept-invite?token=T redirects to `/login?invite=T` (read params from location.search; drop the dead state.from idea), exactly per design.md's AuthGuard block. useLocation is already imported there.

Edit c:\Qivo\apps\web\src\pages\SignupPage.tsx: change the router import to include useLocation, read inviteToken once at component scope from location.search, after setToken navigate to `/accept-invite?token=<encoded>` when present else /dashboard, and set the login cross-link to `/login?invite=<token>` when present.

Edit c:\Qivo\apps\web\src\pages\LoginPage.tsx: change the router import to include useLocation, read inviteToken once at component scope, and apply the same `navigate(inviteToken ? '/accept-invite?token='+encodeURIComponent(inviteToken) : '/dashboard')` in BOTH handleSubmit AND handleGoogleCallback; set the signup cross-link to `/signup?invite=<token>` when present.
Edit c:\Qivo\.env.example (create if absent at repo root): add a comment noting RESEND_API_KEY / EMAIL_FROM / WEB_URL are reused for form-share invites (behavior identical to password reset).
acceptance_criteria: AcceptInvitePage is reachable at /accept-invite behind Protected/AuthGuard; GuestOnly and AuthGuard carry the ?invite= token round-trip; both LoginPage redirect sites (password and Google) honor the invite token.
FormSharePage shows the invite card with role select, shares list with status/role pills, and a working revoke; no new functions were added to lib/api.ts.
verification: Run `pnpm --filter web exec tsc --noEmit` and confirm it passes.
Run `pnpm lint` and confirm no new errors.
Run `pnpm build:web` and confirm it builds.
Final whole-project gate: run `pnpm typecheck && pnpm build:api && pnpm build:web` and confirm all pass.
findings:
Done. Frontend complete and verified: `pnpm --filter web exec tsc --noEmit` = exit 0, `pnpm build:web` = exit 0, and the final whole-project gate (`pnpm typecheck && pnpm build:api && pnpm build:web`, run sequentially since this PowerShell rejects '&&') all passed exit 0.

LINT NOTE: `pnpm lint` reports 6 errors, but ALL are PRE-EXISTING in files this feature did NOT touch (AdminPanelPage, DashboardPage, FormEditorPage, ResponseDashboardPage, TeamPage) — react-hooks/immutability, purity, and set-state-in-effect rules. Verified by (a) linting only the 7 changed files => exit 0 clean, and (b) stashing all web edits and re-running `pnpm lint` => same 6 errors. So NO new eslint errors were introduced; the acceptance criterion 'no new eslint errors' is met. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` cannot currently reach exit 0 due to this pre-existing debt, which is out of scope for FEAT-003.

Files created: apps/web/src/pages/AcceptInvitePage.tsx. Files edited: apps/web/src/types/index.ts (5 share types), apps/web/src/pages/FormSharePage.tsx (invite card + shares list + revoke, 403-on-list surfaced as a benign note), apps/web/src/App.tsx (AcceptInvitePage import + /accept-invite Protected route + GuestOnly useLocation/?invite= carry), apps/web/src/components/AuthGuard.tsx (no-user redirect special-cases /accept-invite -> /login?invite=T, dead state.from dropped), apps/web/src/pages/SignupPage.tsx (useLocation, inviteToken carry, cross-link), apps/web/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx (useLocation, inviteToken read once at component scope, redirect in BOTH handleSubmit AND handleGoogleCallback, signup cross-link), .env.example (reuse comment).

Integration notes: consumed FEAT-002's exact shapes — POST/GET shares -> { share } / { shares: FormShare[] } with user include (token field present on raw rows is ignored, never displayed); DELETE -> { message }; GET /api/invites/:token (publicGet) -> { invite: InvitePreview }; POST accept -> { formId, slug, role } with role redirect EDITOR->/forms/:id/edit, VIEWER->/forms/:id/responses, RESPONDER->/f/:slug. Error branching on ApiRequestError.code: FORBIDDEN (email mismatch / no manage permission), INVALID_TOKEN (bad/used invite). No new functions added to lib/api.ts (api.get/post/delete + publicGet cover everything). SharedWithMeItem type added but no UI section (deferred per design).
